Blending the intensity of classic fighting game intros with the style, heart, and energy of iconic early-2000s anime openings, this cinematic opening sets the stage for the battles ahead.

Produced by renowned Japanese animation studio Sanzigen, the opening animation is directed by Daisuke Suzuki. 

The original theme song, "Stronger as One," features powerhouse vocalists Keiko Terada (SHOW-YA) and mayu (NEMOPHILA), with lyrics by Kanata Okajima and music composed and arranged by MEG (MEGMETAL).

Experience the world of MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls before stepping into the fight.

Roboquest VR - Co-op Update Trailer | PS VR2 Games
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014369

Grab a brobot and get ready to make Haven City twice as loud.

Cross-platform 2-player co-op arrives in Roboquest VR on July 23, letting Guardians team up with friends across supported platforms. Find a partner through Quickplay, connect with a Room Code, or invite a friend directly before heading into the full campaign together.

Build separate loadouts, share weapons, revive fallen teammates, and fight through mechanical swarms side by side. Chests and rewards are generated individually, while shared objectives keep both Guardians moving through each run as a team.

Roboquest VR is a fast-paced roguelite FPS fully rebuilt for virtual reality, featuring more than 70 weapons, manual reloading, physical gunplay, high-speed movement, distinct Guardian classes, procedurally generated runs, and persistent Basecamp upgrades.

Cross-platform co-op will be available as a free update for Roboquest VR on PlayStation VR2 on July 23.

Your great journey begins today.  

After crash landing on a mysterious ringworld known as Halo, the Master Chief is tasked with defending humanity against an overwhelming alien force: the Covenant. With the help of his AI companion Cortana, the Chief must uncover Halo’s dark secrets and fight to avert the annihilation of all life in the galaxy. 

Halo: Campaign Evolved is a faithful yet modernized remake of Halo: Combat Evolved’s campaign, rebuilt from the ground up with high-definition visuals, refined controls, 2-player splitscreen co-op on console, and up to 4-player online cross-platform co-op on console and PC. Enjoy 3 new missions, an expanded arsenal of weapons and vehicles, endless replayability with 42 gameplay modifying Skulls, Campaign Remix, and more. 

Halo: Campaign Evolved is coming to PlayStation on July 28. Pre-order the Premium Edition today and get up to 5 days early access beginning July 23, 2026.

text:
Sniper Dan - Release Date Trailer | PS5 Games
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018326

Sniper Dan is Coming to PS5 on 17 September 2026 (Digital & Physical)

Meet Dan. Dan has a sniper rifle. Don’t panic. He’s not here to harm anyone 😉

Dan’s a professional and his job is fixing things. From a distance. With pinpoint accuracy and very good intentions.

Sniper Dan is a family friendly 3D hidden object game with a ridiculous twist. Instead of clicking on objects, you line up a carefully judged shot and fix the problem in the most unnecessarily precise way possible.

Every job is a small mystery. Spot what’s wrong, read the clues, scope the scene and take the shot. No enemies. No violence. Just everyday problems being politely corrected with long range accuracy.

Explore colourful locations packed with visual jokes, secret jobs and silly situations. Take on special challenges, earn rewards, upgrade your rifle and decorate your office hub as you grow your entirely legitimate problem fixing business.

It’s cosy. It’s comedic. It’s strangely satisfying.

👀 See the problem
🎯 Line up the shot
🌟 Make things right

🎮 Family friendly and non violent

🎯 Hidden object gameplay with a sniper scope twist
